statBlock.name: Ras Nsi
statBlock.description: An exiled Chultan paladin and former warlord who joined the yuan-ti in Omu. He hopes to free Dendar the Night Serpent, but the Soulmonger’s death curse is consuming him.

sections.Traits:
Special Equipment. Ras Nsi wears Bracers of Defense, wields a Flame Tongue Longsword, and carries the Sending Stone paired with Salida’s.
Shapechanger. As an action, he can become a Medium snake or return to yuan-ti form. His statistics stay the same, his equipment keeps its form, and he does not revert when he dies.
Magic Resistance. He has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three melee attacks, using Constrict at most once.
Bite (snake form only). Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing and 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and grapples the target (escape DC 14). The target is restrained while grappled this way. Ras Nsi can constrict only one target at a time.
Flame Tongue Longsword (yuan-ti form only). Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) with two hands, plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma, spell save DC 16. These spells require no material components.
At will: Animal Friendship (snakes only).
3/day: Suggestion.
sections.Spellcasting:
11th-level wizard. Intelligence, spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks.
Cantrips (at will): Chill Touch, Fire Bolt, Mage Hand, Mending, Poison Spray.
1st level (4 slots): Expeditious Retreat, False Life, Magic Missile, Shield.
2nd level (3 slots): Blindness/Deafness, Hold Person, Misty Step.
3rd level (3 slots): Animate Dead, Counterspell, Fireball.
4th level (3 slots): Blight, Polymorph.
5th level (2 slots): Contact Other Plane, Geas.
6th level (1 slot): Create Undead.
sections.Death curse: The printed unweakened average is 127 HP. Begin the adventure with Ras Nsi’s maximum reduced to 107 HP. Subtract 1 more from that maximum for each day that passes.
sections.Fane of the Night Serpent: Ras Nsi can enter any of the five disks in areas 8–12 and continue moving from any other disk in the temple. In his quarters (area 12), he can use a bonus action to say “Ssilum” and animate five shields. They initially raise his AC by 10. When they turn a hit into a miss, one drops and the bonus falls by 2. Only Ras Nsi can activate them, and their effect stays in his quarters. Once all five drop, he needs a long rest before using them again. Sekelok is his bodyguard. Acererak promised to help him free Dendar in exchange for protecting the tomb. If the party can show that stopping the death curse would help him, Ras Nsi may let them proceed.
sections.Printed source: Tomb of Annihilation, appendix D, p. 230. Death curse context, pp. 229–230. Fane teleporters and flying shields, pp. 114 and 121.

statBlock.name: Spiked Tomb Guardian
statBlock.description: The Tomb of the Nine Gods’ dwarves stitch together dead adventurers and bolt the resulting flesh golems into iron armor. Two guardians with spiked gauntlets stand watch in area 41.

sections.Armor: Plate armor bolted to its body (AC 17 for this printing).
sections.Damage immunities: Lightning, poison. Also bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks unless made with adamantine weapons.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Languages: Understands its maker’s languages. Cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Aversion of Fire. After taking fire damage, the guardian has disadvantage on attacks and ability checks through the end of its next turn.
Berserk. At the start of a turn with 40 HP or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6 the guardian goes berserk and attacks the nearest creature it can see. If it cannot reach and attack a creature, it attacks an object, favoring one smaller than itself. It stays berserk until destroyed, healed to full HP, or calmed by its creator. To calm it, the creator uses an action within 60 ft. and succeeds on a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check. The guardian must be able to hear its creator. Further damage at 40 HP or fewer can cause it to go berserk again.
Immutable Form. Spells and other effects cannot change its form.
Lightning Absorption. Lightning damage instead heals it for the same amount.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Spiked Gauntlet attacks.
Spiked Gauntlet. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning and 7 (2d6) piercing damage.
sections.Chained pair (area 41): The two guards attack anyone who strikes them or tries to pass. The chain stops them from moving more than 15 ft. apart and spreads damage to either guardian evenly across both. The chain can be attacked. It has AC 18, 5 HP, damage threshold 10, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. If it breaks, both guardians immediately go berserk.
sections.Printed source: Tomb of Annihilation, ch. 5, p. 154, area 41. The printed adventure gives 7 (2d6) piercing for the gauntlet. Some secondary indexes show 9.

statBlock.name: Stone Juggernaut
statBlock.speed: 50 ft., straight in a direction chosen at the start of its turn
statBlock.description: A massive rolling statue that crushes anyone caught in its path. Acererak named the one in the Tomb of the Nine Gods after Queen Napaka.

sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Also bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks unless made with adamantine weapons.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone.
sections.Traits:
Devastating Roll. The juggernaut can pass through the space of a prone creature. The first time per turn it enters a creature’s space, that creature makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. A failed save deals 55 (10d10) bludgeoning damage. A success halves the damage.
Immutable Form. Spells and other effects cannot change its form.
Regeneration. The juggernaut returns to full HP at dawn if it still has at least 1 HP. Reaching 0 HP destroys it.
Siege Monster. It deals double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions: Slam. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 25 (3d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit must make a DC 17 Strength save or fall prone.
sections.Napaka’s tomb (area 62): The juggernaut waits in area 62D until it takes damage or the door opens. Failing to pick the secret crawlway’s DC 21 lock by 5 or more also releases it. It rolls forward or backward along the hall and needs at least 10 ft. of width. Napaka’s scepter from area 53 destroys it on contact. Touch it with the scepter while it is inert, or hit it with a melee weapon attack using the scepter once it awakens.
sections.Printed source: Tomb of Annihilation, appendix D, p. 231. Area 62 encounter, pp. 172–173. The six ability scores follow the printed block.

statBlock.name: Su-monster
statBlock.description: A vicious primate that stalks caves and remote wilderness. Its tail can hold its weight, leaving all four claws free. A hunting group signals with tails and may bury surplus prey.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage, or 12 (4d4 + 2) if the su-monster hangs by its tail with all four limbs free.
Psychic Crush (recharge 5–6). One creature the su-monster can see within 30 ft. makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. A failure deals 17 (5d6) psychic damage and stuns the target for 1 minute. A stunned target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the effect on a success.
sections.Printed source: Tomb of Annihilation, appendix D, p. 232.

statBlock.name: Tabaxi Hunter
statBlock.description: A catfolk guide and wilderness tracker. Tabaxi hunters carry stories and treasures between far-flung settlements, and know how to keep a party alive in the jungle.

sections.Traits: Feline Agility. When the hunter moves on its turn in combat, it can double its speed until the turn ends. It cannot use this again until it moves 0 ft. on one of its turns.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Claws, Shortsword, or Shortbow.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 2 (1d4) slashing damage.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Tomb of Annihilation, appendix D, p. 232. The printed Shortsword deals slashing damage.

statBlock.name: Tabaxi Minstrel
statBlock.description: A traveling catfolk singer and storyteller. Tabaxi minstrels often roam in small troupes and earn their keep by performing when they reach a settlement.

sections.Traits:
Feline Agility. When the minstrel moves on its turn in combat, it can double its speed until the turn ends. It cannot use this again until it moves 0 ft. on one of its turns.
Inspire (1/day). During a short rest, the minstrel spends 1 minute performing. Choose up to five other creatures that can see and hear it. At the end of the minstrel’s rest, each gains 8 temporary HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claws attacks or two Dart attacks.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 2 (1d4) slashing damage.
Dart. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Tomb of Annihilation, appendix D, p. 233.
